body: It is better to serve like steel than rust and wither away like iron.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: If your business is only to sweep a crossing, remember it is your duty to make that crossing the best swept of the world.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Success in life depends on action, that is, on what you do, and not what you Feel or think, and the price of success is hard work.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Science is a rising force, It is creating a new world about us. It needs to be watched and pressed into service, and in any case, it would be courting disaster to ignore it.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Poverty is... Curable like any disease. Ignorance, dependence, inefficiency, laziness, want of the spirit of enterprise are the real real causes of poverty.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Take care of the pieces well. The whole will take care of itself.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Nature never excuses lapses.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Investigate, educate and organize.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Industrialize or perish.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Courage, conviction and confidence.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: If you buy what you do not need, you will need what you cannot buy.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: The finest task for an Engineer – to survey, to plan, to suggest resources and material, assemble them for task in hand, implement and produce results.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Work does not kill a man, it is worry, irregularity and uncertainty that kill.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Destiny is not a passive agent that lies in the lap of the Gods, but is an active instrument that lies in your own hands to shape as you will.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Investigate, educate and organize the country must progress, productive works and industries are the main avenues at present next to education for the advancement of the country
author: Visvesvaraya

body: I do not want to die rusting, I prefer to burn out.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: You have committed a double mistake, firstly by not keeping the engagement yesterday and secondly, by coming when you were not expected.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: A person who spends more than he earns is a fool
author: Visvesvaraya

body: To give real service, you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money.
author: Visvesvaraya

body: Tell the truth boldly, whether it hurts or not. Never pander to weakness. If truth is too much for intelligent people and sweeps them away, let them go; the sooner the better.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: I, for one, thoroughly believe that no power in the universe can withhold from anyone anything they really deserve.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: The whole secret of existence is to have no fear. Never fear what will become of you, depend on no one. Only the moment you reject all help are you freed.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Who makes us ignorant? We ourselves. We put our hands over our eyes and weep that it is dark.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Desire, ignorance, and inequality—this is the trinity of bondage.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Great work requires great and persistent effort for a long time. …  Character has to be established through a thousand stumbles.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Learning and wisdom are superfluities, the surface glitter merely, but it is the heart that is the seat of all power.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Work and worship are necessary to take away the veil, to lift off the bondage and illusion.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Religion as a science, as a study, is the greatest and healthiest exercise that the human mind can have.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: All differences in this world are of degree, and not of kind, because oneness is the secret of everything.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: Purity, patience, and perseverance are the three essentials to success and, above all, love.
author: Swami Vivekananda

body: You may never have proof of your importance but you are more important than you think. There are always those who couldn’t do without you. The rub is that you don’t always know who.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Don't worry that children never listen to you; worry that they are always watching you.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Yelling at living things does tend to kill the spirit in them. Sticks and stones may break our bones, but words will break our hearts...
author: Robert Fulghum

body: It doesn’t matter what you say you believe - it only matters what you do.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Peace is not something you wish for; it is something you make, something you are, something you do, and something you give away.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Live a balanced life - learn some and think some and draw some and paint some and sing and dance and play and work everyday some.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: If you break your neck, if you have nothing to eat, if your house is on fire, then you got a problem. Everything else is inconvenience.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Above all, if what you've done is stupid, but it works, it ain't stupid.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: If you tell people you talk to God, they'll think you're religious, but if you say God talks to you, it's ten to one they'll think you're crazy.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: The heart will turn to a prune if love is always by the numbers. How will you know if someone really loves you if they only meet your expectations and not your needs?
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Speed and efficiency do not always increase the quality of life.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: I've always thought anyone can make money. Making a life worth living, that's the real test.
author: Robert Fulghum

body: Education is the best friend. An educated person is respected everywhere. Education beats the beauty and the youth.
author: Chanakya

body: A man is great by deeds, not by birth.
author: Chanakya

body: There is some self-interest behind every friendship. There is no friendship without self-interests. This is a bitter truth.
author: Chanakya

body: Books are as useful to a stupid person as a mirror is useful to a blind person.
author: Chanakya

body: Once you start a working on something, don't be afraid of failure and don't abandon it. People who work sincerely are the happiest.
author: Chanakya

body: As soon as the fear approaches near, attack and destroy it.
author: Chanakya

body: Purity of speech, of the mind, of the senses, and of a compassionate heart are needed by one who desires to rise to the divine platform.
author: Chanakya

body: Do not reveal what you have thought upon doing, but by wise council keep it secret being determined to carry it into execution.
author: Chanakya
